sampling_model.design: Finite full-history sequential multiple-assignment randomized trial with the supplied kernel \(e_h(a)\), represented by the joint equalities \(P(H=h,A_h=a)=e_h(a)P(H=h)\).
sampling_model.treatment: At each reached node \(h\), treatment uses the known design kernel \(e_h\). The design supplies \(e_h\) at every legal node, including dormant nodes, while counterfactual conditional-kernel versions on null fibers are completed only by the theorem-level extension lemma.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nuisance regression is required for finite-sample inversion; observed trajectory-cell probabilities enter the reach-rescaled linear program directly.

body.tldr: In a finite SMART, the observed law identifies each regime-outcome marginal but not the dependence needed for the perfect-information outcome \(M_Q=\max_{d\in\mathcal D}Y(d)\). The project characterizes every compatible discrete oracle-outcome pmf through local maximum-law capacity inequalities recursively linked over the full-history tree. Its field-tier headline is a projection-and-lift theorem universal over observed laws obeying known positive randomization: each recursively feasible array extends to one complete law \(Q\) preserving that observed margin, with consistency, exchangeability, single-world factorization, and reached-history modularity imposed on \(Q\). A separate kernel-extension lemma completes dormant zero-probability fibers without strengthening the causal model. Corollaries give a tree-sized polytope, exact certificates, attaining samplers, an explicit strictly nonrectangular positive witness, and finite-sample whole-set confidence inversion for oracle remission in SMART-BD.

project_justification.gap: Static sharp distributional bounds characterize pointwise limits for functions of two potential outcomes, and published oracle-DTR bounds identify sharp binary endpoints and two simultaneous CDF envelopes. Neither literature characterizes all attainable discrete oracle laws or verifies a complete dormant-branch lift for every interior law.
project_justification.niche: The ordered finite outcome support turns local coupling compatibility into a small capacity system, while the full-history SMART tree supplies a laminar recursion that generic response-type programs do not exploit.
project_justification.fill: For every observed law obeying known positive randomization, the tree-diagonal projection theorem equates this recursion with complete FFRCISTG laws whose observed margin is fixed and on which consistency, exchangeability, factorization, and reached-history modularity hold. A theorem-level finite kernel-extension argument coordinates null-fiber versions after the substantive lift, and the resulting corollaries compress the sharp set and map simultaneous multinomial uncertainty through the same program.

body.related_work: Shahn2026Oracle is the direct causal anchor: its Theorem 1 gives sharp binary oracle bounds, and Section 4 constructs two bounding CDFs for bounded outcomes. The present target is the distinct interior set of discrete oracle pmfs and its complete counterfactual lift. FanPark2010 Lemma 2.1 is the closest static sharp distributional-bounds comparator: it gives pointwise best-possible CDF bounds for \(Y(1)-Y(0)\) from two identified marginals and notes that the envelopes need not be uniformly sharp. Its static pairwise setting does not perform the first dynamic SMART-tree step here, namely coupling action-specific continuation maxima at every full history and gluing those conditional couplings across descendants into one observed-law-preserving complete FFRCISTG system. Artstein1983 provides the capacity-inequality language for random selections, and LaiRobbins1976 provides an extremal common-marginal maximum coupling; both inform the local construction without serving as claimed tightening targets. Ponomarev2024 Theorem 1 characterizes the smallest nonredundant Artstein-inequality collection for broad set-valued-prediction models and uses bipartite-graph connectivity in finite spaces. The local system here is structurally different: it targets the law of a maximum of heterogeneously margined coordinates, reduces locally to \(mK\) lower-set inequalities plus \(K\) singleton diagonal inequalities, and links them by mass conservation over a treatment tree; it does not claim to improve Ponomarev's minimal collection for his generic correspondence problem. RichardsonRobins2013SWIG fixes FFRCISTG semantics through single-world factorization and modularity on reached distributions; exact agreement of chosen conditional versions on dormant zero-probability fibers is supplied by a separate finite kernel-extension lemma. GreseleEtAl2022 supplies a finite response-function representation of categorical causal compatibility and motivates auditing global gluing. Russell2021 supplies the generic random-set and optimal-transport benchmark, whereas the treatment-tree formulation exploits reach rescaling and laminar structure. OberReynolds2023 and HuangEtAl2017 inform the inference layer. ShpitserTchetgen2016 clarifies why the result is stated under FFRCISTG and does not impose the stronger NPSEM-IE cross-world model.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The transport construction and reduced LP calculations are diagnostics, not established theorems. An independent finite response-type calculation matched the reduced formulation in 160 support directions over ten heterogeneous positive two-stage binary-action, binary-intermediate, three-outcome kernels, with maximum absolute discrepancy \(6.7\times10^{-16}\). This numerical kill test checks effective response-tree projection but does not certify the complete FFRCISTG response-system embedding. The separate dormant-kernel extension is finite equivalence-class bookkeeping once a reached response system exists; it does not resolve the global lift. Any recursively feasible point lacking such a lift invalidates the projection-and-lift statement and requires replacing \(\mathcal R(P)\) by the projected global polytope or adding the first missing facet. The claimed complexity is in explicit tree size; it is not polynomial in horizon under a compressed state representation.
body.honest_scope: The local finite maximum-law iff has a concrete monotone-residual transport route. The complete dormant-branch FFRCISTG response-system lift under known randomization, positivity, and ordinary reached-history modularity remains the genuine open content and is the premise for the compact-LP, sampler, nonrectangularity-as-an-identified-set, and inference corollaries. Exact agreement of kernel versions on dormant null fibers is a separate theorem-level extension problem and is not maintained as a causal assumption. The nonrectangularity witness displays its envelope coordinates, interior candidate, excluding facet, positive-cell margin, and relative open-neighborhood perturbation argument. Static continuous copula diagonals, unknown-randomization inference, restricted policy classes, missing outcomes, and NPSEM-IE tightening are outside the theorem claims. The binary reduction to Shahn2026Oracle is mandatory.
